record.reason: OmniScript introduces hierarchical audio-video script generation and a long-video data/model pipeline; experiments compare script quality across multimodal models. Full text focuses on annotation, temporal grounding and generation quality, not token/KV reduction or inference acceleration.
record.title: OmniScript: Towards Audio-Visual Script Generation for Long-Form Cinematic Video
